errors.evidence: The description states there are 27 countries, but there are 28 bars representing 28 countries on the x-axis.

The list of countries provided in the description is incomplete; it omits Greece (Гърция) and Croatia (Хърватия), which are visible on the x-axis. The provided list also contains only 26 countries, not the 27 claimed or the 28 actually present.
The description claims the countries are in an arbitrary order, but they are clearly sorted in descending order based on their corresponding bar heights (the EGDI value).

The description states the values range from approximately 0.6 to 0.9. However, the lowest bar (Romania) has a value of approximately 0.75, and the highest bar (Denmark) has a value close to 1.0 (approx. 0.98).
